title: Feasibility Testing of a Hospice Family Caregiver Intervention to Improve Patient Dyspnea Care
brief_summary: This study is a pilot test of an intervention to train family caregivers of home hospice patients about recognizing and treating shortness of breath.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient in home hospice care with an estimated survival of 3-4 weeks, at risk for dyspnea secondary to lung cancer, COPD, or heart failure.
* Family caregiver in patient's home must speak and read English.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with bulbar ALS or quadriplegia.
